title: H06 — Outlier Count IQR (Medium)
prompt: The file data/housing_dataset.csv contains housing price data. Identify outliers in house prices using the IQR method. Apply the 1.5×IQR rule: consider any price below Q1 - 1.5×IQR or above Q3 + 1.5×IQR as an outlier. Report the total number of outliers. Report your answer in this exact format: @total_outliers[value] where value is an integer.
notes: Uses numpy.percentile for Q1/Q3, exactly matching the requested methodology — most textbook-correct implementation in the set.
